import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    vis = [False] * p  # indices 0..p-1
    components = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not vis[i]:
            v = i
            while not vis[v]:
                vis[v] = True
                v = (v * k) % p
            components += 1
    ans = pow(p, components + (1 if k == 1 else 0), MOD)
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
